name: MS500
summary: MS500 is an Oradar rotating-mirror dToF LiDAR offered by Orbbec for industrial robot perception. It supplies a 270-degree scan through Ethernet for warehouse AMRs, AGVs and navigation, with an IP65 enclosure and configurable scan frequency.
